applies_to: Every IME comparison reported after registration, including the first scoring of any new blind release; earlier frozen results keep their original primary metric
primary_metric: Exact Top-1 against the frozen acceptable forms, full denominator including pool misses (unchanged from v1)

secondary_metrics.notation_lenient_top1: Exact Top-1 plus wrong choices that are a conservative notation variant (equal UniDic lemma sequence AND nested kanji sets) of a reachable acceptable form; vimeml.benchmarks.notation
secondary_metrics.pool_conditional_top1: Exact Top-1 over the cases whose frozen candidate pool contains an acceptable form

statistics.per_item: Exact two-sided McNemar on discordant cases (kept for comparability with v1 reports)
statistics.cluster_primary: Two-sided paired sign-flip permutation over author clusters (WRIME UserID, JMultiWOZ user, Legacy source document; homophone group on the challenge track; otherwise each case); exact enumeration up to 20 discordant clusters, else 20000 seeded draws
statistics.cluster_interval: 95% percentile interval of the net paired difference, 10000 cluster bootstrap draws, seed 0
sensitivity: template clusters: NFKC targets with digits masked, character-trigram Jaccard >= 0.5
union of author and template clusters
statistics.design_effect: Clustered over independent variance of the paired total

decision_rule: A claimed Top-1 improvement needs exact Top-1 net > 0 on the primary track with cluster_primary p < 0.05, and no notation-lenient loss with cluster_primary p < 0.05 on any reported track. Per-item McNemar alone is not sufficient

track_roles.legacy-regression: Notation regression alert for old web text (draft references); not a capability metric
track_roles.ajimee: Public encyclopedic/written check; semantic errors reported; contamination not excluded
track_roles.historical-development: Smoke test only: flagged when exact Top-1 drops by more than 3 cases; not used for comparisons
track_roles.homophone-challenge: Written-text semantic challenge (ime-homophone-ja-v1, frozen before candidate export): exact Top-1 and notation-lenient Top-1; diagnostics: accuracy when the reference is the more frequent vs the second lemma of its group, and pairs with both items correct. Items are paired by homophone group, so homophone-group clusters are the cluster unit
track_roles.standard-v2-blind: Primary confirmation track (ime-standard-ja-v2-blind): consumed once, after a committed model plan; coverage statistics are opened together with that scoring, not before
track_roles.incremental-prototype: Protocol prototype on exposed development messages (dictionary-draft labels); segment Top-1, message exact match teacher-forced and free-running; never a capability claim

candidate_pools.primary: AzooKey n-best 20 (converter d59a28e4, typo off, Zenzai off), unchanged for comparability
candidate_pools.secondary: n-best 50 from the same converter and flags, reported beside n20 for the v2 blind and homophone tracks; switching the primary pool requires a new metric version
